# Project Overview

This project analyzes survey data from Employees Federal Credit Union.
The dataset contains 128 respondents and measures employee service,
overall ratings, loan usage, and customer perceptions.

# Key Measures

- Overall credit union rating
- Employee courtesy
- Employee helpfulness
- Employee professionalism
- Employee availability
- Current loan usage

# Key Findings

Most valid responses rated the credit union as Excellent or Good.
Employee courtesy and helpfulness received particularly strong ratings.
The analysis also identified opportunities to improve employee
availability and promote relevant loan products.
